text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Spike in 5xx and elevated token latency on inference-api-prod (us-west-2). Paging on-call.
Jordan: I'm on it. Confirming paging — getting on voice. Noted customer-facing endpoints affected: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Starting triage.
Jordan: quick context — rolling deploy of kernel-optimizer v2 happened ~12m ago. Telemetry shows a sharp up in p50/p95 token times and ~20% 5xx across all models.
Sam: seeing the same in metrics. Heatmap shows a hot shard on GPU pool g-pool-3, memory OOM on a worker host. Logs: `kv-cache: evict-failed: oom` repeated.
Alex: I pushed a temporary routing rule to divert traffic away from g-pool-3 to g-pool-1 and g-pool-2. Should be instantaneous.
deploy-bot: Routing change applied by Alex at 1790123460. Canary rollback of kernel-optimizer v2 initiated by Jordan.
Jordan: executing rollback now to kernel-optimizer v1. Rolling 10% -> 30% -> 100%.
Sam: scaling up fallback pool while rollback proceeds: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-worker --replicas=40 -n prod`. Also disabled continuous batcher for affected queue to reduce mem pressure.
Sam: mitigation looks stable — p95 latency trending down. 5xx rate dropping from 20% -> 4% in last 3m.
Jordan: thanks. I'm going to notify Ops and CS with an initial status page update draft. Emma, can you start a customer-facing follow-up draft? We'll need a timeline and mitigations.
Emma: starting draft below. Marking items I need clarified (TBD).
Emma: STATUS PAGE NOTE (initial):

We are investigating elevated errors and latencies impacting the inference API in us-west-2. Engineers are actively mitigating; some requests may experience errors or delays. We'll provide updates every 30 minutes.

(Will update when rollback completes and full scope is known.)

Emma: CUSTOMER-FACING EMAIL DRAFT (do not send yet):

Hi <Customer Name>,

We detected a service disruption affecting the inference API in the us-west-2 region starting at approx 2026-03-15T18:10:56Z. Some requests returned errors or experienced increased latency. Our engineers have implemented mitigations (traffic re-routing and rollback of a recent runtime change) and error rates are returning to normal.

We will follow up with a full incident summary and root cause analysis within 48 hours. Please reply if you saw an ongoing impact beyond 18:20 UTC.

Apologies for the disruption,
Emma, Customer Success on behalf of Redwood Inference

Maria: timeline note — please capture exact times for routing change and rollback completion. Jordan/Sam can you paste the deployment and routing timestamps so I can include them in the post-incident message?
Jordan: routing change applied at 1790123460 (approx 18:14:20 UTC). Rollback completed at 1790123480 (approx 18:15:00 UTC) — deploy-bot shows 100% success.
Sam: scale command launched at 1790123465 and new workers registered by 1790123478. Memory OOM spikes stopped after rollback + scale.
Alex: root-cause hypothesis: regression in kernel-optimizer v2 that increased KV cache retention and pushed memory beyond expected limits under peak prefix loads. Repro steps in staging failing to reproduce due to different usage pattern — working on a deterministic repro.
Jordan: handoff to Sam for post-incident ops analysis. I'll keep CS looped for customer comms. Sam — are you taking action items for the RCA and prevention plan?
Sam: taking. Initial action items: 1) reproduce locally with large prefix workloads (assigned to Alex), 2) add canary health checks that validate memory KPI pre-rollout (assigned to Sam), 3) add automatic rollback threshold on mem errors (assigned to Jordan/SRE). I'll write a short ops runbook.
Emma: for the customer follow-up, I'd like a concise timeline and the specific mitigations we used. Can you all confirm the phrasing: "We rerouted traffic away from an impacted GPU pool and rolled back a recent runtime optimization, which restored normal service" — is that accurate? If yes I'll use it.
Sam: accurate.
Jordan: accurate. Also include: we scaled additional fallback capacity to absorb traffic during mitigation.
Emma: perfect. I'll finalize the email and the status page entry once we have the confirmed timestamps and a brief RCA bullet list.
incident-bot: Scheduled update: next status page post at +30m. Action required: confirm incident severity and customer list.
Emma: can someone pull the customer-impact list (who had active requests in us-west-2 between 18:10-18:20 UTC)? I can personalize outreach if needed.
Alex: running a query now; will paste results to private thread. (sensitive)

Jordan: thanks team — once Sam attaches the RCA bullets I'll prepare the final customer note. Also let's schedule a 30-min post-incident sync in 2 hours to go over prevention and timeline details. :calendar:
Emma: pinging legal for compliance checks on notifications for affected enterprise customers.

Sam: quick note to include in RCA: the canary rollout percentages were 10/20/50/100 but the canary health gating didn't surface memory under certain heavy prefix scenarios. We'll propose adding a memory-pressure detector to gating logic.
Emma: finalizing customer email (below). Please approve: 

Subject: Incident summary — Inference API (us-west-2) — Short interruption on 2026-03-15

Hi <Customer>,

Between 18:10–18:20 UTC we observed increased errors and latency for the inference API in the us-west-2 region. Impact: some requests returned 5xx and some had high latency.

What we did: diverted traffic from the affected GPU pool, scaled fallback capacity, and rolled back a recent runtime change. These mitigations restored normal service by 18:15 UTC.

Next steps: we are completing a root cause analysis and will share a full RCA within 48 hours, including steps to prevent recurrence.

If you have any concerns or saw continued impact, reply to this thread and we'll prioritize follow-up.

Thanks and apologies for the disruption,
Emma (Customer Success) on behalf of Redwood Inference

Jordan: :thumbsup: from me. Sam, Maria — any objections? If none, Emma can send the customer emails after we post the status update.
Sam: no objections. I'll attach the preliminary RCA bullets to this thread in 20m.
Maria: schedule confirmed for post-incident sync at 20:30 UTC. I'll take notes and follow up on action items.
Alex: adding a ticket to backlog for a reproducible regression test. Ticket: INF-4821.

Emma: sending status page update now (initial) and preparing targeted customer messages. Will BCC support@redwood for tracking.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2 by Jordan. Timeline and notes will be appended to the incident after the postmortem meeting.

Jordan: closing the live mitigation loop — thanks everyone for the quick turn. We'll reopen if anything regresses.

Emma: will follow up with customers and post the RCA summary.

(End of thread)
